title: 第17章 灵矿第18章 郁凌打架了
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第17章灵矿
文院长和首席交谈后，联系上了陈老，现在他所认识的能和郁凡联系上的也就是陈建业了。
陈老得到郁凡的首肯后，才敢将文院长带进别墅区。
文恒看到陈建业，差点以为自己眼花。
这才几天不见，陈老怎么就年轻了这么多？
他内心跟猫抓了似的，憋了很久，还是忍不住询问了起来。
陈建业也不藏着掖着，他很清楚郁凡的打算，所以自然是做个活广告将郁凡的招牌打出去。
“郁神医，现在已经60岁了，您看他是否比我还年轻?”陈建业笑了笑提示着。
文恒一震，陈建业突然变年轻也是这一两天的事情，能快速将人变年轻，可不仅仅只是医术而已了。
他神色严肃的对陈建业说：“陈老，能否请您在医院做一个全面的检查？”
如果，身体的机能都如外表一样恢复了年轻时候的状态，那这对于人类而言，可是一件极具重要的事情了。
陈建业笑着点头，“当然可以。”
黑色的劳斯莱斯幻影直入别墅区。
文恒不清楚这栋别墅原本是属于陈家的，还以为是郁凡自己的，感叹不已。
他在海市这么多年，作为军区医院的院长，他人脉极为广泛，但据他所知能住在这里的都是顶级富豪了。
这里最为普通的一套别墅都是价值二十亿，更别提郁凡所住的是别墅区最为独特的区域。
可以称的上是月影山庄的楼王了，一套下来，可能没有小三十亿是拿不下来的。
最为关键的是不仅仅只是有钱就能买到，更重要的是权。
可想而知，这套房子的价值几何了。
陈老这次过来除了将文院长带过来也是给别墅送一批人过来。

偌大的别墅打扫起来也麻烦，陈老一次性带了十个人过来，都是他精挑细选的老实可靠的人。
郁凡看到那几个人都挺满意的，越发觉得陈建业是个会办事的人。
文院长早已看过郁凡的照片，也知道他的年纪，可真的看到本人也不由觉得惊叹。
真的会有这样逆天的人存在吗？
“郁神医，打扰您了，今日前来，也是有事相求。”文桓极为诚恳的表达了他的想法。
“关于您治疗陈子轩的事情，想询问一下您究竟是用何方法治疗的？”虽然是院长，但本职也是一个医生，对于医术上的事情，文院长不免想要询问一番。
可又担心唐突了郁凡，听赵医生所说，对方使用的是金针，那必然是中医，据他所知，不少厉害的中医都是有自己的传承所在的。
并不会随意去透露自己的信息。
“如果您不方便也没有关系，但鄙人还是希望能邀请郁医生能在军区医院坐镇。”
“军区医院的医疗团队一直都是华国顶级的，也希望能和郁医生进行学术交流。”
郁凡沉默了一瞬，他并不是真正的医生，若说学术交流这对于他来说也并没有多大的用处。
content_en:
Chapter 17 Spirit Mine
After Dean Wen talked with the chief, he contacted Mr. Chen. Now the only person he knew who could contact Yu Fan was Chen Jianye.
Only after Mr. Chen got Yu Fan's approval did he dare to bring Dean Wen into the villa area.
When Wen Heng saw Chen Jianye, he almost thought he was dazzled.
We haven't seen each other for a few days, how come Mr. Chen has become so much younger?
He felt like a cat was scratching his heart. After holding it in for a long time, he couldn't help but ask.
Chen Jianye didn't hide it either. He knew Yu Fan's plan very well, so naturally he made a living advertisement to show off Yu Fan's brand.
"Doctor Yu, he is 60 years old now. Do you think he is younger than me?" Chen Jianye reminded with a smile.
Wen Heng was shocked. It only took a day or two for Chen Jianye to suddenly become younger. Being able to quickly make people younger is not just about medical skills.
He said to Chen Jianye seriously: "Mr. Chen, can you please do a comprehensive examination in the hospital?"
If the body's functions are restored to the state of its youth just like its appearance, then this is a very important thing for human beings.
Chen Jianye smiled and nodded, "Of course."
The black Rolls-Royce Phantom entered the villa area.
Wen Heng didn't know that this villa originally belonged to the Chen family, and thought it belonged to Yu Fan himself, and sighed.
He has been in Haishi for so many years. As the director of the military hospital, he has extremely extensive connections, but as far as he knows, the only people who can live here are the top rich.
The most common villa here is worth two billion, not to mention that Yu Fan lives in the most unique area of ​​the villa area.
It can be said that he is the king of the Moon Shadow Villa. If you buy one set, you may not be able to get it without a small three billion.
The most important thing is that it is not just money that can buy it, but more importantly, power.
You can imagine how valuable this house is.
When Mr. Chen came this time, in addition to bringing Dean Wen here, he also sent a group of people to the villa.
Cleaning such a large villa is troublesome, so Mr. Chen brought ten people here at one time, all of whom he carefully selected to be honest and reliable.
Yu Fan was quite satisfied when he saw those people, and he felt more and more that Chen Jianye was a person who knew how to get things done.
Dean Wen had already seen Yu Fan's photos and knew his age, but he couldn't help but feel amazed when he saw him in person.
Does such a rebellious person really exist?
"Doctor Yu, I'm sorry to bother you. I came here today to ask for something." Wen Huan expressed his thoughts very sincerely.
"As for your treatment of Chen Zixuan, I would like to ask what method you used to treat it?" Although he is the dean, he is also a doctor. Regarding medical matters, Dean Wen can't help but want to ask.
But Yu Fan was worried about being abrupt. He heard what Dr. Zhao said that the other party used golden needles, so they must be Chinese medicine. As far as he knew, many powerful Chinese medicine doctors had their own inheritance.
He will not reveal his information at will.
"It doesn't matter if it's inconvenient for you, but I still hope to invite Dr. Yu to sit in the military hospital."
"The medical team at the military hospital has always been top-notch in China, and I hope to have academic exchanges with Dr. Yu."
Yu Fan was silent for a moment. He was not a real doctor, and academic exchanges were not of much use to him.
